### ? Why do starters fail in winter?

Status: open · 5 replies
- Sven: an oven with only the light on sits around 26 °C.

### [Keeping a starter in a cold kitchen](https://kingarthurbaking.com/keeping-a-starter-in-a-cold-kitchen)
<!-- id:p1 type:page at:520,60 size:260x250 -->
Move it somewhere warmer, use warmer water, or feed it less often until spring.
Keywords: temperature, proofing, levain

### Report: What temperature range do starters need?
<!-- id:r1 type:report at:40,290 size:260x270 -->
Most sources put the working range at 24–27 °C [1][3]. Below about 20 °C the yeast slows more than the bacteria, so the starter turns sour and rises less [2].
AI-assisted · 6 sources
